comment: cmd.c get_count() shows 'Count: N' through custompline(SUPPRESS_HISTORY); a MSGTYPE=stop rule matching it makes vpline() wait at --More-- and clear the top line. 'Count: 23' does not match and is shown plainly. Escape at the second --More-- sets WIN_STOP, which the next readchar() clears, so 'Count: 154' is shown.
